results.title: Suicidal thoughts for teens peak in high school: study
results.description: South Korean teens have more suicidal thoughts in high school than they did in middle school, with such tendencies peaking in the second year, a recent case study showed Sunday. Second-year high school students on average scored 1.58 out of 4 in terms of having suicidal thoughts, in the study published by the National Youth Police Institute.
